name: Bronte McKinnon
bio:
Bronte McKinnon's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for aircraft and aerodynamics. Growing up near an airfield, she spent hours watching planes take off and land, sparking an early interest in fluid dynamics. This fascination led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics and wind tunnel testing.

After graduating, Bronte joined RSC Motorsport, initially as a junior technician. Her methodical approach and keen eye for detail quickly made her an invaluable asset to the team's wind tunnel operations. She has a knack for identifying subtle airflow anomalies and translating them into actionable insights for the aerodynamicists. Bronte thrives in the structured environment of the wind tunnel, dedicating herself to meticulous data collection and analysis. She's known for her calm demeanor, even under pressure, and her ability to maintain focus during long testing sessions.

Bronte’s strength lies in her ability to stay calm and focused. She's a firm believer in the importance of thoroughness and accuracy in wind tunnel testing, ensuring that the team’s aerodynamic development is built on a solid foundation of reliable data. Her loyalty to RSC Motorsport is unwavering, and she is a dedicated member of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Bronte has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

Insists on precisely calibrating the wind tunnel instruments before each test run.
